sentences.text: [Order of the Court was made by S.M.SUBRAMANIAM, J.]
The notice issued under Section 7 and the consequential order under Section 6 by the Tahsildar, Thiruvottriyur are under challenge in the present writ petition.
2. After issuing notice under Section 7, an opportunity was afforded to the alleged encroachers.
Thereafter, Section 6 order has been passed.
An order passed under Section 6 is susceptible to an Appeal under Section 10 of the Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act, 1905.
Thus, the aggrieved person is at liberty to submit an appeal before the District Collector within a period of 10 days from today.
On receipt of any such Appeal, the District Collector shall conduct an enquiry and pass appropriate orders.
In the event of https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis identification of encroachments, the encroachers are directed to be removed.
The entire exercise is directed to be completed within a period of 12 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
3. It is made clear that if the District Collector came to a conclusion that the subject land is Government land, encroachers are not entitled for the compensation for the land.

However,
compensation is to be granted for the superstructures, if any constructed by the persons.
4. In this regard, it is for the aggrieved persons to establish the same and after ascertaining the facts in detail all necessary actions are to be initiated.

The Chennai Metro Rail Limited (CMRL) is also at liberty to contest the case before the District Collector in the event of preferring an Appeal by the petitioner under Section 10 of the Tamil Nadu Land Encroachment Act, 1905.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 5.
With this liberty, this Writ Petition stands disposed of.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Miscellaneous Petition is closed.

[S.M.S., J.]
